items.title: Delta CEO on FAA ground stop: “We need to find out what went wrong”
items.summary:
Delta Air Lines CEO Ed Bastian told the F500 Innovation Forum he believes Friday’s nationwide FAA ground stop came from “a combination of faulty equipment, coupled with human error.”

He dismissed other explanations as currently lacking evidence.

items.title: SpaceX’s Starlink Is United’s “Biggest Near-Term Competitive Advantage” in 100 Years, CEO Says
